system.description:
The fighting that came out of the slave pits of the Red Waste: not taught, not codified, discovered through survival. It isn't elegant, but it is devastating.

  • Hard to Kill: the first time each encounter you drop below half HP, your next unarmed hit deals an extra unarmed damage die.
    • 9th level, Pit-Forged Fury: when you use your action to attack, your primary unarmed attack can target up to 2 creatures within 5ft (one roll against each).
  • Survivor's Instinct: Advantage on Constitution checks against exhaustion, extreme temperatures and starvation, and you know the signs of someone else who survived the pits.
